11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
12	
13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
17	
18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
23	-/

41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
42	
43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
46	def PicRankOneOpen :
47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
55	      apply Subtype.ext
56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
57	    rw [e]
58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

60	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
61	
62	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
63	
64	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
65	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
66	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
67	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
68	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
69	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
70	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
71	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
72	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
73	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
74	
75	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
76	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
77	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
78	contract. -/
79	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
80	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
81	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
82	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
83	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
84	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
85	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
86	  rfl

90	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
91	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
92	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
93	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
94	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
95	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
96	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
97	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h

99	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
100	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
101	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
102	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
103	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
104	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
105	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h

107	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
108	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
109	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
110	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι

112	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
113	
114	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
115	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
116	relative-open gate below. -/
117	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
118	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
119	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
120	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
121	
122	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
123	
124	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
125	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
126	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
127	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
128	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)

16	/-!
17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
18	
19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
23	
24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
29	
30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
36	-/

59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
60	
61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
69	  represents :
70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
72	  datum_class :
73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
76	  module_iso :
77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
90	  h0_rank_one :
91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
93	
94	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
95	
96	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
97	
98	noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
99	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
100	    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
101	  Scheme.moduleKSections
102	    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U
103	
104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
105	
106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
112	  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
114	
115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
121	      P.module :=
122	  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module
124	
125	/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/
126	
127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
128	
129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/

166	/-- **The twisted family whose chart-membership `chartLocus` tests**: the plus class `λ`
167	shifted by the Σ-family of `Z` and by `m` inverse powers of the pinned θ-family.
168	
169	This is the *class-side* half of `chartValue` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`): where

174	def chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
175	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : picEt C T :=
176	  lam * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m) * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹

178	/-- **The degree ledger of the twist**: at every field point the twisted family has fibre
179	degree `m·d₁ − deg Z` when `λ` is degree-zero.  With the chart-index constraint
180	`deg Z = m·d₁ − g` this is `+g`, which is the degree at which an effective witness with
181	`h¹ = 0` can exist at all.

183	**Sign discipline, and it was wrong here until 2026-07-28 (issue I-0514).**  `chartTwist`

# Base-local triviality: relPicMk-equality localizes to on-the-nose equality

Two Čech Picard classes `L, L'` on the relative curve `C ⊗ Spec B` with equal image in the
relative Picard group `relPic C (overSpec k B)` differ by a class pulled back from the base
along the second projection (`relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff`).  A base class is, through the
Čech–Picard dictionary of the affine scheme `Spec B` (`Scheme.CechPic.toPic`), an invertible
`B`-module; invertible modules are finite projective, hence free at the stalk of every prime
`q`, and freeness spreads from the stalk to a basic open `D(f) ∋ q`
(`Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers`).  So the base discrepancy
dies after localizing at `f`, and the two classes agree on the nose after base change to
`Localization.Away f`.

## Main declarations

* `CommRing.Pic.exists_notMem_mapAlgebra_eq_one` — Zariski-local triviality of the Picard
  group of a commutative ring: near every prime some basic-open localization kills a given
  Picard class.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_notMem_cechPicMap_specMap_eq_one` — the same statement for Čech
  Picard classes of `Spec B`, through `toPic` and its naturality (`toPic_map`).

/-! ## Zariski-local triviality of the Picard group of a ring -/

/-- **Zariski-local triviality of the Picard group**: for every Picard class `P` of a
commutative ring `B` and every prime `q` there is an `f ∉ q` such that `P` dies in
`Pic (Localization.Away f)`.  The representative invertible module is finite projective,
hence free at the stalk of `q` (`Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing`), and freeness spreads
from the stalk to a basic open
(`Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers`). -/
theorem CommRing.Pic.exists_notMem_mapAlgebra_eq_one {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    (P : CommRing.Pic B) (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    ∃ f : B, f ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
      CommRing.Pic.mapAlgebra B (Localization.Away f) P = 1 := by
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation B P.AsModule :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_projective B P.AsModule
  haveI : Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl P.AsModule) :=
    Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfree, -⟩ :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers q.asIdeal.primeCompl
      (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap q.asIdeal.primeCompl P.AsModule)
      (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  haveI := hfree
  rw [CommRing.Pic.mapAlgebra_apply, CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one_iff_free]
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv
    (LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct (Submonoid.powers f) P.AsModule)

/-! ## Local triviality for Čech Picard classes of an affine base -/

/-- **Zariski-local triviality of the Čech Picard group of `Spec B`**: every Čech Picard
class of the affine base dies after pullback along `Spec` of a localization
`B → Localization.Away f` with `f` outside a given prime — `toPic` naturality
(`Scheme.CechPic.toPic_map`) plus injectivity of `toPic` on the target transports
`CommRing.Pic.exists_notMem_mapAlgebra_eq_one` through the `ΓSpecIso` bridge. -/
theorem exists_notMem_cechPicMap_specMap_eq_one {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    (N : (Spec (CommRingCat.of B)).CechPic) (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    ∃ f : B, f ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
      Scheme.CechPic.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f)))) N = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hone⟩ := CommRing.Pic.exists_notMem_mapAlgebra_eq_one
    (CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).hom.hom
      (Scheme.CechPic.toPic (Spec (.of B)) N)) q
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  set φ : CommRingCat.of B ⟶ CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away f) :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f)) with hφ
  -- the descent homomorphism of the (affine) target is injective
  apply Scheme.CechPic.toPic_injective
  rw [map_one, Scheme.CechPic.toPic_map]
  -- inject further along the ring isomorphism `Γ(Spec (Away f), ⊤) ≃ Away f`
  have hΓinv : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (Localization.Away f))).inv.hom.comp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (Localization.Away f))).hom.hom = RingHom.id _ := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, CommRingCat.hom_id]
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (Localization.Away f))).hom.hom) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h2 := congrArg
      (CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (Localization.Away f))).inv.hom) hxy
    rwa [CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom, CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom, hΓinv,
      CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_id_apply, CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_id_apply] at h2
  apply hinj
  -- naturality of `ΓSpecIso` turns the global-sections square into the algebra map
  have hnat : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (Localization.Away f))).hom.hom.comp
      (Spec.map φ).appTop.hom = φ.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).hom.hom := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality]
  rw [map_one, CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom, hnat,
    ← CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom, hφ, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
    CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_algebraMap]
  exact hone

/-- **Base-discrepancy localization**: two Čech Picard classes on the relative curve
`C ⊗ Spec B` with equal image in the relative Picard group agree on the nose after base
change to `Localization.Away f`, for some `f` outside any given prime `q` of the test ring.

The discrepancy `L / L'` is pulled back from the base (`relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff`), and base
classes die Zariski-locally (`exists_notMem_cechPicMap_specMap_eq_one`); the commuting square

theorem exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] {L L' : (relCurve C B).CechPic}
    (h : relPicMk C (overSpec k B) L = relPicMk C (overSpec k B) L')
    (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    ∃ f : B, f ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) L
        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) L' := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (mem_picFromBase_iff C).mp ((relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff C).mp h)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hkill⟩ := exists_notMem_cechPicMap_specMap_eq_one N q
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  have hdiv : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) (L / L') = 1 := by
    rw [← hN, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_snd,
      Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, MonoidHom.comp_apply, hkill, map_one]
  rwa [map_div, div_eq_one] at hdiv

/-- **Base-discrepancy localization for widened divisor families** (the `picClass`
consumer): if two widened locally certified families of degree `genus C` over `B` have
`relPicMk`-equal Picard classes, then near every prime of `B` their `mapAlgHom`-restrictions
to a basic-open localization have equal Picard classes on the nose. -/
theorem DivFamZarAff.exists_notMem_picClass_map_eq_of_relPicMk_eq
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (F F' : DivFamZarAff C B (genus C))
    (h : relPicMk C (overSpec k B) F.picClass = relPicMk C (overSpec k B) F'.picClass)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    ∃ f : B, f ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B (Localization.Away f)) F).picClass
        = (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B (Localization.Away f)) F').picClass := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hmap⟩ := exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq h q
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B (Localization.Away f))
      (fun _ => rfl) F,
    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B (Localization.Away f))
